detail.longDescription: I'm working with the latest Google Maps JavaScript API and trying to display service locations nusig the newer AdvancedMarkerElement API. The base map configuration appears to work, but I'm having trouble understanding how marker rendering differs from the older google.maps.Marker implementation. Does AdvancedMarkerElement require additional configuration, such as loading the marker library through google.maps.importLibrary("marker") and setting a valid Map ID? Are there any important migration differences or common issues when switching from the legacy marker API to AdvancedMarkerElement ?
